initial_audit: Existing incidence-corrected formulas already test zero counts, but the earlier fixed witnesses use constant left labels and did not classify arbitrary label assignments. General voltage-cycle elimination is classical. The present exact fixed-base histograms and family are explicit follow-up calculations, not a new literature-open conjecture.
conclusion: Classical prior work answers the general design principle. We supply explicit all-N fixed-base label counts, actual incidence/counting bridges and a [[140q,18,6]] family, with a checked Lean version of every manuscript proof and independently verified q=2 instance. No mathematical, code-parameter or formalization priority is established.

sources.title: Lowering the Error Floor of LDPC Codes Using Cyclic Liftings

sources.comparison_limit: Inspected2010preprint, not a page-by-page comparison with the final2011journal revision. The fixed two-base all-N joint label histogram and this precise CSS family were not identified in inspected passages.
